description.narrative: The Sharing Environment and Energy Knowledge (SEEK) activity objective is provide services and support to enable four E3 Offices Forestry and Biodiversity (FAB), Global Climate Change (GCC), Energy and Infrastructure (EI) and Water to improve staff knowledge, skills and abilities; support knowledge creation, capture and use, and share knowledge internally and among a wide range of stakeholders; enhance communication and outreach to inform and engage key audiences using multiple approaches and channels; and strengthen organizational capacity for greater efficiency and learning for improved development impact.
